descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S16 Step 1 per context: identity fields on the card, summary label, billing-family hint in the picker

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1b Identity fields per context. The Hospital card shows name, room, chief diagnosis, age/sex, badge and hospital day. The Nursing Home card shows name, unit/room, MRN, facility, badge and visit number, … (UAT TC-21 step 1; UAT TC-01; UAT TC-03) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1c The summary label is 'Background Summary' in Hospital and 'Admission Summary' in Nursing Home (UAT TC-21 step 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1d The billing family follows the context's templates, as a fixed table keyed on the template selected at Generate (not the badge). … (UAT TC-21 step 1; UAT TC-21 expected (billing); UAT TC-18; TFA-92599 rule 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fixture: Hospital patient diagnosis 'Community-acquired pneumonia'; resident diagnosis 'Post-acute rehab after hip fracture' stored (make-session.ts)

When Look at each list card, each chart's Pre-Round tab and each chart's Encounter tab (badge default Follow-up, picker closed)

Then Hospital card shows the chief diagnosis; NH card shows no diagnosis. Hospital chart says 'Background Summary', NH says 'Admission Summary', never the other. The NH picker's selected template carries the SNF family hint (99307…) and no Hospital code; the Hospital picker carries no SNF code.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per checkpoint, from UAT TC-01 (Hospital card has the chief diagnosis), TC-03 (no diagnosis on the NH card; main shows it, so a Fail is expected, Q8), the TC-21 step 1 label (HospitalCoursePanel.tsx / CoursePanel.tsx), and the TC-18 family table for the picker hint. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
